content.value: On June 1, 2018 Mr. Amin established the Dhaka Travel Agency. The following (20) transactions were completed during the month:

content.value_html:
2018
June 1Invested Tk. 200,000 cash in the agency
June 2Paid Tk. 5000 cash for June office rent
June 3Purchased office equipment for Tk. 25000 cash
June 4Incurred advertising expenses of Tk. 3000 in the "Daily Desk" on account
June 5Paid Tk. 5000 cash for office supplies
June 6Earned Tk. 120,000 for service rendered: cash Tk. 30,000 isreceivedfrom customers and the balance of Tk. 90,000 is billed to customers onaccount.
June 7Paid the "daily desk" amount due in transaction (4)
June 8Withdrew cash Tk. 4000 for personal use
June 9Paid salaries to employees Tk. 15,000
June 10Received Tk. 90,000 in cash from customers who have previously beenbilled in transaction June (6)
